_comment: Mutation testing for the form-view characterisation specs. Runs entirely locally - the only cloud reporter Stryker has is 'dashboard', which is deliberately not enabled here and would need an API key. Scope a run with --mutate, e.g. npm run test:mutation -- --mutate 'src/views/inventory/MaterialForm.vue'.
_ignorer_comment: stryker-vue-ignorer skips Vue compiler macros (defineProps, defineExpose, ...). They are hoisted out of setup() by the SFC compiler, so instrumenting them fails to compile - and a props declaration has nothing worth mutating. Without this every <script setup> file would need a 'Stryker disable all' pragma around its defineProps.
_ignorestatic_comment: ignoreStatic is deliberately OFF. It must stay off for the model layer: src/models/**/*.ts is almost entirely module-level constants (valibot schemas, field-tuple groups), so nearly every mutant there is a 'static' mutant. With ignoreStatic on, Stryker cannot activate those mutants per test and reports them as Survived rather than Ignored - order-schemas.ts scored 4.94% (4 killed, 77 survived) with it on and 72.84% (59 killed, 22 survived) with it off, from the identical test suite. The four mutants it did classify correctly (in schema.ts) are all killed once it runs them. The cost is a slower run, since Stryker has to re-evaluate the module per static mutant.
